# flickersofmajesty: what it can do, and how it got here

A fine-art photography dropship storefront (flickersofmajesty.com) of hand-written static HTML pages built on the FOM-Lite Protocol that makes listings readable by AI assistants.

## How we got here

Every change entry, newest first: what it was for, and what it made possible.

### 20261109-hook-tmp-paths

Task `hook-tmp-household-sweep-20261109`.

**Why.** This repo's hooks redirected to fixed /tmp files; where another user or job owned one, the redirect failed and its command never ran, so encoded memories could silently fail to persist, and its directive hook was an old copy that only looked for ken's older rule.

**Enables.** memory-autopersist (and reasoning-log-persist where present) try the append and fall back to a per-user file, and memory-directives-inject is the Project-Sophos canonical: it loads the open-claw-stuff directive rule first and writes its error detail to a per-run file.

**Untested:** this repo has no hooks test folder; with the default autopersist log path made a directory, the patched hook committed the memory file; admin/hook-tmp-path-lint.mjs (Project-Sophos) reads this repo CLEAN; the mechanism is pinned in Project-Sophos .claude/hooks/tests/hook-log-fallback.test.mjs

### 20261101-observer-post-commit-hook

Task `argus-s32-observer-all-repos`.

**Why.** This repository had no Argus observer hook, so its commits, reverts and test receipts were never captured and a lesson learned here could not open a need in another repository.

**Enables.** Every commit here is captured as an event after it lands, advisory only: the hook cannot refuse a commit, runs nothing when ARGUS_OBSERVE=0, and says on stderr when no Argus checkout is found.

**Untested:** The hook body is generated by Argus and its behaviour is pinned by tests in the Argus repository (observer-hook-cli.test.mjs, 58 observer tests passing there); this repository has no test for it. Here the file was checked by sh -n, a mode check, byte equality across the rollout, and an opt-out probe that exited 0 silently.

### 20261028-change-record-in-flickersofmajesty

Task `change-record-deploy-repos-20261028`.

**Why.** flickersofmajesty had no record of why its code changes: a commit message keeps what changed, not why it mattered, and the reason lived only in the memory of whoever made it. Ken asked on 2026-10-27 for the household change record in every repository, tuned to each.

**Enables.** Every commit here that changes the storefront's pages, styles, standards and admin tools now carries why it mattered and what it enables, judged when it is made, while changes to the product, collection and category listings alone need no entry.

**Untested:** This commit installs the gate here; the engine and this repository's tuning are tested in Project-Sophos, in admin/tests/change-record.test.mjs and admin/tests/change-record-deploy.test.mjs.
